title: Perttu v. Richards
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

cue.text: If a dispute over whether a prisoner used the prison grievance process (required by the Prison Litigation Reform Act) is intertwined with the merits of a claim that requires a jury, the parties are entitled to a jury trial on that dispute too.
